RQ1.rationale: Provides a general CubeSat mission modeling architecture and power-budget abstractions, but not a reusable EPS behavioral reference model.

RQ2.rationale: Claims rapid exploration, inter-disciplinary integration, and decision support; reliability/reproducibility/integrability outcomes are not EPS-specific or independently demonstrated.

RQ3.rationale: Contains pre-physical parametric feasibility checks for power and platform selection, but no formal EPS verification procedure or IVV model.

bibliographic_review_management.lineage_overlap_notes: Cites INCOSE Space Systems Working Group CubeSat/MBSE work and RAX CubeSat MBSE operational scenarios, but this paper's extracted contribution is an independent MATLAB-based mission trade-space architecture.

study_context_population.mission_platform: LEO CubeSat/nanosatellite mission architecture with two illustrative mission cases.
study_context_population.size_form_factor: CubeSat units selected discretely (1U, 2U, 3U, ... NU); case results note transitions such as 2U to 3U.
study_context_population.mission_name: not reported; generic Earth-observation and scientific-payload case studies
study_context_population.organization_type: Academic research laboratory with industry-linked EPSRC iCASE studentship involving Clyde Space Ltd.
study_context_population.project_maturity: Conceptual/early design methodology and executable research prototype; not a flight program report.

mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Manual point-design mission analysis and isolated discipline trades are slow and may miss near-optimal CubeSat mission designs; the paper proposes a rapid model-based architecture linking decision variables to cost/performance metrics.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_and_abstraction: Mission-level CubeSat architecture with trajectory, space segment, launch segment, ground segment, and performance modules at conceptual analytical/parametric fidelity.
minimal_or_excluded_modeling: No detailed numerical orbit propagation for most visibility calculations.
Only circular orbits and long-term averages are considered for trajectory variables.
No detailed EPS dynamic behavior, fault protection, software, hardware integration, or flight operations model.
Cost is comparative rather than final price estimate.
Complete novel mission design is out of scope.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Mission requirements, objectives, decision-variable bounds, payload/communication demands, OTS CubeSat subsystem data, and analytical equations/assumptions for orbit visibility, power sizing, cost, lifetime, and de-orbit behavior.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.limited_behavioral_knowledge_handling: Uses analytical approximations, long-term averages, conservative/safety factors, OTS databases, simplified duty-cycle assumptions, and penalty functions to screen many designs without detailed behavior models.
direct_quotes: Section 1.1: "a baseline structure can be maintained with modifications of the inputs and requirements made for each use case."
Abstract: "This work presents an architecture that identifies trends between conflicting objectives... and decision variables..."

generality_reuse_mechanism_v1_1_reasonin.rationale: The reusable contribution is a baseline CubeSat mission-design architecture/workflow and guidance, not a fully mission-agnostic or interface-focused model. The paper explicitly says the architecture cannot be completely generalized but can be maintained as a baseline with modified inputs/requirements. Its generality also depends on high-level analytical abstractions and deliberate avoidance of detailed/numerical dynamic behavior. The current 'specific-mission model with reusable method only' is overstated because the paper demonstrates two generic use cases rather than one specific mission model.

evidence.quote: Since each space mission is unique, the model architecture introduced here cannot be completely generalized, however a baseline structure can be maintained with modifications of the inputs and requirements made for each use case.

The general design structure matrix is shown in Figure 1... A set of inputs, which includes the mission requirements, feeds each of the mission disciplines, from which one or more performance metrics are produced.
The models within the architecture exploit analytic methods where possible, in order avoid computationally expensive numerical propagation, and achieve rapid convergence.
Since this work considers only long-term averages with respect to orbit trajectory, the position variables... remain undefined.

implementation_steps_or_phases.completion_criteria: Objectives, variables, bounds, constants, and constraints encoded.

ivv_integration_level.rationale: The highest supported IVV integration level is executable/model-based feasibility or constraint checking inside the mission-design model. This should not be upgraded to trace-linked verification artifacts, simulation-in-the-loop, SIL/HIL, or formal EPS V&V. The evidence is model-executed parametric checks for feasibility, power sizing, and constraints before physical development.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: Analytical, model-based architecture enables rapid exploration of large CubeSat mission design spaces by avoiding repeated numerical orbit propagation.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.linked_artifact_or_process: MATLAB discipline model architecture; analytical trajectory/visibility methods; MOGA search.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_or_qualitative_effect: Two-case optimization ran 51,000 model iterations in 10 minutes; conclusion claims visibility assessments in fractions of a second instead of minutes for numerical approaches.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: "These results were obtained in 10 minutes on a personal workstation... solution convergence after 102 generations (i.e 51,000 iterations of the model architecture)." / "This allows rapid, long-term visibility assessments to be made in fractions of a second (as opposed to minutes... using numerical approaches)".
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: No independent runtime benchmark or accuracy validation versus numerical propagation; speed may depend on simplified mission assumptions and hardware.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: The architecture finds Pareto sets of near-optimal CubeSat mission designs from user-defined design spaces.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.linked_artifact_or_process: Controlled elitist MOGA applied to trajectory, space, launch, ground, and performance modules; Pareto plots in Figures 4-7.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_or_qualitative_effect: Pareto sets are shown for GSD/revisit and data-return/cost trade studies; decision variables include altitude, inclination, and ground-station latitude.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: "Global multi-objective optimization... is applied to the architecture and is shown to find a Pareto set of near-optimal solutions from an arbitrary, user defined design space."
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Case studies are synthetic/illustrative and Pareto fronts depend on model assumptions, penalty functions, and OTS database values.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: The model exposes non-intuitive design trends that could be missed by point-design methods.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.linked_artifact_or_process: Case II solution-space projections over cost, data return, altitude, inclination, and GS latitude.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_or_qualitative_effect: Two major optimal altitude regions are identified, including discrete transitions associated with platform changes and de-orbit device inclusion.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: "It is clear that there are no continuous trends which might have been immediately obvious to a system designer, highlighting perhaps the most important feature of this work."
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Non-intuitive trends may arise from chosen cost, component, de-orbit, and platform-discretization assumptions; no user study compares against actual designers.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: The architecture integrates multiple mission disciplines so cost and performance can be traded at whole-mission level.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.linked_artifact_or_process: Figure 1 design structure matrix and discipline data flow among trajectory, space, launch, ground, and performance models.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_or_qualitative_effect: The workflow jointly computes cost/performance metrics instead of treating inter-domain trade studies in isolation.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: "A set of inputs, which includes the mission requirements, feeds each of the mission disciplines, from which one or more performance metrics are produced."
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Integration is internal to a research MATLAB model; no multi-team/tool deployment or semantic interoperability evidence is reported.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_or_qualitative_effect: Potential robustness improvement is asserted; no reliability, uncertainty, or robustness metric is reported.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Robustness may require uncertainty analysis, margin tracking, or validation not included in the paper.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.reliability_subtype_rationale: Mission robustness is a reliability-adjacent, mission-level assurance claim, but it is asserted without EPS reliability evidence.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: For each solution-space point, the architecture defines a baseline system design that can be carried forward as knowledge grows.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.linked_artifact_or_process: Baseline system design per solution-space point; evolving model across lifecycle.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_or_qualitative_effect: Authors propose carrying additional parameters into detailed behavioral simulation, operations scheduling, or sensitivity analysis.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: "Development of the models through the life-cycle, as information becomes available and experience grows, would allow additional parameters to be calculated..."
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: No actual downstream lifecycle handoff, repository, or detailed simulation is demonstrated.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text_or_paraphrase: EPS-adjacent power feasibility can be embedded in early CubeSat platform selection via power demand, battery, solar-array, and volume/cost checks.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.linked_artifact_or_process: Figure 2 space segment design process; Sections 3.1.1-3.1.4 power, battery, and solar equations.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_or_qualitative_effect: Candidate CubeSat units are screened for total power demand, battery capacity, solar panel area, volume feasibility, mass/cost, and lifetime/de-orbit compliance.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: "The battery capacity calculated in equation (5) is the minimum required to satisfy the demands from the platform, so the battery device would be a discrete size available that exceeds this."
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Sizing uses simplified assumptions and does not validate EPS dynamic behavior, margins, faults, or hardware performance.

practical_implementation_pathway.rationale: Architecture, equations, process flow, optimizer, decision-variable bounds, and two executable case studies provide an evidence-backed partial pathway.

toolchain_fragmentation_interoperability.rationale: The paper mentions acausal parametric tools and reports MATLAB implementation but does not solve toolchain fragmentation or report exchange mechanisms.

lightweight_resource_constrained_tailori.rationale: The method is explicitly tailored to small, modular, resource-limited CubeSats and evidenced through simplified analytical modeling and case results.

governance_project_deliverables_roi.rationale: Cost and candidate-selection decision support are present, but governance, project deliverables, lifecycle gates, and ROI evidence are not substantively addressed.

newspace_agile_distributed_rapid_iterati.rationale: Rapid-iteration needs for commercial/resource-limited CubeSats are addressed and supported by a runtime/iteration metric; agile/distributed practices are not discussed.

RQ1: A baseline CubeSat mission architecture can model trajectory, space, launch, ground, and performance disciplines with mission-specific inputs and requirements.
EPS relevance is power-budget/electrical-architecture only: subsystem loads, battery sizing, solar-array sizing, and feasibility/cost contributions.
Limited behavioral knowledge is handled through analytical approximations, long-term averages, OTS component data, conservative factors, and penalty functions.
RQ2: Claimed outcomes include rapid trade-space exploration, Pareto-set decision support, broader solution-space coverage, inter-disciplinary integration, and possible robustness/lifecycle continuity.
Best evidence is executable case-study results and a runtime metric; reliability/reproducibility/integrability outcomes are not proven with independent validation, reuse, or flight/test evidence.
Reproducibility is partial because equations/settings are reported but model/data/code are not available.
RQ3: Pre-physical checks include power, battery, solar-array, volume, lifetime, de-orbit, and constraint/penalty screening.
No formal EPS verification procedure, verification matrix, test cases/procedures, model checking, SIL/HIL, or hardware integration/test evidence is reported.
The paper's 'verifies the model architecture' statement is a simple case-study sanity check, not EPS IVV.
